title: Variable popover
brief: Edit a {{variable}} from the input where it is used (Postman-style): hover or click a mark in the URL, grids, auth fields or bodies to see and edit its value, with secrets, unresolved quick add, no active environment and typing states.

artboards.title: Inline edit popover
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest: edit at the mark with no layout change; one scope shown, the chain is a single 'overrides' line

artboards.title: Hover tooltip + side inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Hover is read-only and safe; editing in a docked panel shows the full scope chain but costs a click and 308 px of pane
